sentences: Traders moved $458 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-08-03, across 19.4 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 72% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 28%.
The most-traded market was "Will the U.S. invade Iran before 2027?", pulling in $2 million of volume.

An unusual reversal: retail traders outperformed bots this week. Active retail earned $4K (+450 bps on volume) while algorithms lost $18K (-119 bps). Weeks like this are rare (bots are typically on top by the execution channel).
